boundary.description: From the junction of East Park Road and Preston New Road, E along Preston New Road and Barbara Castle Way. By a beeline S to and along Ainsworth Street, then W along Church Street, Higher Church Street, SW along Astley Gate, King Street, Whalley Banks and Bank Top. Then N along Garden Street, W along Wensley Road. Then by a bee-line NE to and along Crosshill Road, and E along Preston New Road.
